events.continuity_hook: Adds a final access update to the already booked Kansas City utility trip.
events.interaction_goal: Update the site-access notes, confirm the hotel and car logistics still support the earlier arrival time, and leave the booked flight and hotel unchanged.
events.scenario_brief: The Kansas City utility sends its final visitor packet after Jonah has already booked the Monday flight, rental car, and suburban hotel. The plant now wants him at a south contractor gate for a 6:45 a.m. badge handoff, with parking moved to a gravel lot outside the operations building and PPE kept in the rental car. He does not want to reopen the travel choices; he only needs the itinerary notes tightened, the rental pickup window checked against his Monday arrival, and the hotel early-departure plan verified.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new distributor-and-plant episode after the Kansas City pre-trip details are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, hotel, and rental-car shortlist that protects the Thursday training start while keeping the sample-board and Friday timing questions visible.
events.scenario_brief: A Southern California distributor asks Jonah to run a membrane-cleaning lunch-and-learn and then join a validation run at a bottling plant near Anaheim the next morning. He needs Bay Area flights into Orange County or nearby airports that arrive Wednesday evening with enough time to review slides, avoid two-stop routing, and include a rental car for the plant visit. Hotel options should compare Irvine, Costa Mesa, and Anaheim-area practicality, with strong guest feedback, parking, and quick dinner options. The open items are whether the sample valve board can ship directly to the distributor and whether the Friday plant slot might run late.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Orange County planning after the training time and shipping details become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the airport and flight choice, decide which hotel location fits the two-site schedule, and keep the rental-car timing aligned with both work stops.
events.scenario_brief: The distributor confirms they can receive the sample valve board, but the Thursday training moves to an 8:30 a.m. start, making a Wednesday arrival nonnegotiable. Jonah wants to narrow the flight choices between a better-timed SFO-to-Santa Ana nonstop that is not on United, a United option into LAX with a later drive, and an Oakland itinerary with a longer connection. For hotels, he is weighing a better-rated Irvine property with easier dinner choices against a cheaper Anaheim option closer to the Friday plant visit.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Orange County distributor and bottling-plant trip from comparison to booking.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room notes, seat selections, and concise two-day work itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah chooses the Wednesday afternoon SFO-to-Santa Ana nonstop because it avoids LAX traffic and preserves an evening slide review, even though it is not the preferred carrier. He books a Friday evening return from Santa Ana after the plant validation, a compact rental car, and the better-rated Irvine hotel with parking and nearby restaurants. The room notes should request a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and he wants window seats selected where available.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a lighter personal travel episode after several work-focused trips.
events.interaction_goal: Shortlist practical flight, rental-car, and hotel options for the weekend while showing the trade-off between Plaza walkability, parking convenience, and the possible Sunday versus Monday return.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah and his spouse start planning a Santa Fe long weekend around galleries and a Saturday dinner reservation. They are looking at a Friday afternoon Bay Area departure into Albuquerque with one clean connection if needed, a rental car for the drive to Santa Fe, and either a Sunday evening or Monday return depending on PTO approval. Hotel options should compare a high-rated inn near the Plaza against a newer property with easier parking, with walkability and restaurants carrying more weight than workday room routines. The unresolved items are whether Monday PTO is approved and whether the Plaza premium is worth it.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Santa Fe personal weekend from comparison to booking once the return date is settled.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the weekend flights, rental car, hotel booking, room notes, seating approach, and compact personal itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah's spouse gets Monday PTO approved, so they can avoid a rushed Sunday return. They choose a Friday afternoon Bay Area-to-Albuquerque itinerary with one efficient connection, a Monday afternoon return, a compact rental car, and the higher-rated Plaza-area inn because it supports the dinner reservation and walkable weekend plans. Seat choices should keep them together first, with a window seat only if it works within that arrangement, and the hotel can note a quiet king room and mini-fridge if available.
